name: Curse of Slate Rock Manor
source:
Delilah and her friend Lyle grow worried after their fellow student fails to return in time for their graduation ceremony. Their friend Trent had left after finals to investigate a number of recent ghost sightings in Slate Rock , but failed to show up for graduation. After no clues show up during a forensic investigation a few weeks later, Trent becomes classified as missing, and Lyle and Delilah decide to conduct an investigation of their own. 

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130717095343/http://visualnovelgames.com/VN-Curse-of-Slate-Rock-Manor.html]Visual Novel Games[/url]]
translation:
迪莱拉和朋友莱尔担心一名同学未能按时参加毕业典礼。特伦特期末考试后前往斯莱特岩调查近来频现的幽灵目击事件，却没有出席毕业典礼。数周后的法证调查毫无线索，特伦特被列为失踪人员，莱尔和迪莱拉决定自行展开调查。

[摘自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130717095343/http://visualnovelgames.com/VN-Curse-of-Slate-Rock-Manor.html]Visual Novel Games[/url]]
